title: Version 2.1.132 Released
description: Claude Code v2.1.132 released with multiple bug fixes and improvements including session ID environment variable, alternate screen opt-out, improved SIGINT handling, terminal fixes for various IDEs (Cursor, VS Code, JetBrains), and MCP server error handling improvements.

title: Context Usage Breakdown
description: Cursor 3.3 introduces context usage breakdown feature allowing developers to see detailed stats about their agent's context consumption across rules, skills, MCPs, and subagents to diagnose issues and optimize setup.

title: Enterprise-Managed Plugins in GitHub Copilot CLI Public Preview
description: GitHub Copilot CLI introduces enterprise-managed plugins in public preview, allowing organizations to control and manage CLI plugin access and configuration for their teams.

title: Version 2.2.17 - Devin Review & Quick Review Integration
description: Windsurf IDE v2.2.17 released with Devin Review and Quick Review now available to all users, Agent Command Center improvements with list display, better session sorting/filtering, and Windows update bug fixes.

title: Model Controls, Spend Management, and Usage Analytics
description: Cursor releases enterprise admin updates including granular model access controls at provider/model level, updated spend management, and enhanced usage analytics with option to block new providers by default.
